name: Blood and Lust and Lust for Blood
source:
After returning to the house, he spent a summer in as a child, Dimitri discovers that what he had thought were simply childish delusions might have been realer than he imagined.

[From [url=https://pine-needle-animations.itch.io/blood-and-lust-and-lust-for-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Dimitri回到了那棟兒時曾度過一個夏天的房子，卻發現那些自己原以為只是童年妄想的事情，或許比想像中更接近現實。

[摘自[url=https://pine-needle-animations.itch.io/blood-and-lust-and-lust-for-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
